Bill.BriefDescription: Reducing toll project costs by transferring sales and use tax collections to the project's tolling account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the transfer of sales and use taxes on tollprojects to reduce the amount of the project; and adding a new sectionto chapter 82.32 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax imposed and collected under chapters 82.08 and 82.12 RCW,less any credits allowed under chapter 82.14 RCW, on initialconstruction of a street, place, road highway, easement, rightofway,bridge, tunnel, or trestle in which eighty percent of the cost of theproject must be recovered through tolls, shall be transferred to thetolling account of the project and used to lower the overall cost ofthe project and thereby the corresponding tolls.
